note: Every figure used by the simulation. 'observed' figures come from a published source; 'assumption' figures are modeling estimates with a stated range. Confidence tags: HIGH (80%+), MEDIUM (50-80%), LOW (<50%). Observed figures were retrieved through search-result summaries because the build environment could not reach census.gov, panynj.gov, or njtransit.com directly; re-verify before relying on them.

residents.source: U.S. Census Bureau population estimate, July 1, 2024

ageShares.source: ACS 2024 age groups (under 15: 13.6%, 15-24: 11.4%, 25-44: 52.7%, 65+: 6.8%); 45-64 is the remainder; the split of under-15 into 0-4 and 5-14 is an assumption

commuteModeShares.source: ACS 2024 1-year, means of transportation to work, via Data USA

pathHobokenAnnual2025.source: PANYNJ PATH ridership, 2025 (Hoboken ranked 6 of 13 stations). The station was closed for 25 days in Jan-Feb 2025 for track work.

njtRailHobokenWeekdayBoardings2025.source: NJ Transit average weekday boardings, 2025 (3rd of 153 stations)

nyWaterwaySystemWeekday2022.source: NY Waterway average weekday ridership, Sept 2022, all 18 terminals (Hoboken share not published)

stevens.source: Stevens Institute of Technology facts and statistics, fall 2025

usHouseholdsWithDog.source: AVMA 2025 Pet Ownership and Demographic Sourcebook: dogs in 42.6% of US households (87.3 million dogs)

pathHobokenWeekdayEntries.method: 2025 annual entries / ~290 weekday-equivalent open days (232 open weekdays + weekends at ~55% of a weekday + holidays at ~50%)

households.method: (residents - ~2,600 in Stevens dormitories) / 2.10 persons per household

residualCommuteModeShares.note: ACS residual after WFH, transit and drove-alone is 10.4%; this split is an estimate

residentTransitSubmodes.note: Set so modeled PATH entries land inside the derived 15,500-19,000 weekday range once NJ Transit-to-PATH transfers are included

jobsLocatedInHoboken.note: LEHD/OnTheMap was unreachable from the build environment; estimated from the employer mix (Stevens, hospital, schools, city government, waterfront offices, ~700 food and retail venues)

inboundWorkersWeekday.note: Jobs in Hoboken filled by non-residents and actually on site on a typical weekday (part-time, remote and days off removed)

inboundStudentsWeekday.note: Stevens students who live outside Hoboken and come to campus on a weekday

visitorsWeekday.note: Dining, nightlife, shopping, waterfront, medical visits, business meetings

njtRailTransfersWeekday.note: NJ Transit rail riders who change to PATH, ferry, light rail or bus inside Hoboken Terminal without entering the streets. Set so modeled NJ Transit boardings (Hoboken-origin riders + returning transfers) match the published 7,790 average weekday boardings.

householdSizeShares.note: Chosen to reproduce the 2.10 average household size

householdsWithDog.note: No Hoboken count is published (the city licenses dogs but doesn't report totals). Set at about half the national 42.6% share for a city of small apartments and 2.1-person households. One adult walks the dog two or three times a day, to one of Hoboken's 8 dog runs or a nearby park.
